nodes.label: Eventar product description
nodes.rationale: A CPD/CME compliance platform for regulated professions. Practitioners attend accredited events; Eventar records attendance and issues tamper-evident credit the regulator will accept. Status: Stage 10 (2026 dual-track); pivoted 2026-07-03 from an internal workshop manager; the event/attendance/QR-checkin loop carries forward as the backbone.
